root_cause: paper-fleet-reconciler and paper-signal-producer cached a single static PANTHEON_RUNTIME_MANAGER_TOKEN string at process initialization instead of minting fresh short-lived HS256 JWTs or re-reading rotated token files on each RuntimeManager request, causing minted/short-lived runtime-manager bearer tokens to expire under long-running processes.

changes.services/runtime_auth.py: Extended RuntimeManagerAuthConfig and resolve_runtime_manager_auth to mint fresh short-lived HS256 JWTs on each headers()/token evaluation when signing secret/actor/role env vars are configured (source='jwt_mint'), re-read token_file on stat mtime/size/inode changes or JWT exp expiry when file-backed (source='token_file'), preserve _BoundAuthToken back-references when passed through RuntimeIdentity.runtime_manager_auth.token, redact secrets/tokens in __repr__/status_dict, and preserve explicit static token and permissive default fallbacks.
changes.services/runtime-manager/runtime_manager: Bound RuntimeManagerClient._bearer_token dynamically to self._auth.token with setter support and accepted RuntimeManagerAuthConfig / _BoundAuthToken without freezing a single startup token string.
changes.services/paper_fleet_reconciler/paper_fl: Replaced static self._token header string freezing with resolve_runtime_manager_auth and per-request self._runtime_manager_headers() in _fetch_fleet_state and _transition_binding (including _token setter and uninitialized __new__ instance compatibility), while propagating token_file or dynamic env config to spawned worker subprocesses without logging token or secret values.
changes.services/execution/lean_runtime/paper_si: Updated fetch_eligible_paper_bindings and main() to resolve RuntimeManagerAuthConfig and generate dynamic Authorization headers on every desired-state and binding-detail HTTP request without freezing a startup token string or logging credentials.
changes.services/execution/lean_runtime/runtime_: Isolated explicit env mappings from os.environ when env={} is passed and added RuntimeIdentity.runtime_manager_headers().
changes.docker-compose.yml: Wired PANTHEON_RUNTIME_MANAGER_TOKEN_FILE, PANTHEON_RUNTIME_JWT_SECRET, PANTHEON_RUNTIME_JWT_ISSUER, PANTHEON_RUNTIME_JWT_AUDIENCE, PANTHEON_RUNTIME_MANAGER_ACTOR_ID, and PANTHEON_RUNTIME_MANAGER_ROLES into paper-fleet-reconciler and paper-signal-producer while preserving static fallback defaults.

runtime_budget.cadence: per-request in-memory HS256 header generation / bounded os.stat check on existing RuntimeManager poll cycles (reconciler 15s, producer 60s)

residual_findings: Other non-paper runtime-manager callers (monitor-agent, incidents, postmortems, reconciliation-drift-svc/consumer, openclaw-gateway-adapter live_gate_adapter/paper_broker_adapter) still read static PANTHEON_RUNTIME_MANAGER_TOKEN directly from os.environ while runtime-manager defaults to PANTHEON_RUNTIME_AUTH_MODE=permissive (tracked under RC5 in docs/operations/problem-register.md).
